summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results and declared an annual cash dividend of approximately US$230 million. The company also noted over US$300 million in share buybacks completed year-to-date, bringing total shareholder returns through dividends and buybacks to exceed 100% of prior year's adjusted net income. The filing is a routine earnings release with a dividend declaration, but the combination of a large dividend and buyback program may signal a special capital return initiative. However, no specific dividend per share, payment date, or buyback authorization details are provided. What to watch: any future announcements on dividend record dates and buyback program expansion.
